name: Gini Silk Mills Limited
about: Gini Silk Mills Limited manufactures and sells shirting and suiting products under the GINI brand in India. The company offers cotton blends, printed cotton fabric, linen, wrinkle-free polyester cotton, lyocell, viscose, bamboo, and hemp, as well as processes fabric on a job work basis. Gini Silk Mills Limited was founded in 1963 and is based in Mumbai, India.
